verdict.rationale: Trivy's official trivy-mcp plugin starts an MCP server that connects Trivy scanning to AI tools. It advertises 'Natural Language Scanning' for asking questions about security issues, which plausibly covers AI explanation of findings. Nothing in the evidence shows AI-driven deduplication or false-positive flagging, and the natural-language capability is only a one-line claim. Missing for 10: documented AI explanation of individual findings, AI deduplication of findings, AI false-positive flagging, hands-on or independent corroboration of the MCP triage workflow.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can use AI to triage findings — explaining them, deduplicating, and flagging likely false positives

citations.quote: Natural Language Scanning: Ask questions about security issues in natural language
This plugin starts a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that integrates Trivy's security scanning capabilities with VS Code and other MCP-enabled tools.
